content: If you have a garden and a library, you have everything you need.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
story:
Watching the Roman Republic collapse into military dictatorship and civil war, Cicero used his oratorical mastery to defend constitutional liberty, paying with his life when Mark Antony's soldiers assassinated him in 43 BC. In his final philosophical writings, he articulated the immortal duties of civic honor, moral justice, and courageous friendship.

In formulating this reflection, Marcus Tullius Cicero stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of simplicity. For Marcus Tullius Cicero, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
